display.purpose: The 40px tape count — the page's single oversized element; never shrinks at any breakpoint.

title.purpose: The row's position link; the sans voice for the listing's name.

body.purpose: Page default for sentences: locations, notes, empty-state subtext, toast.

label.purpose: Column heads, rail summaries, buttons, dividers — mono uppercase, tracked 0.14–0.24em.

figures.purpose: Every count, date, code, index number, and key-cap; always tabular-nums.

shadows.name: tab-underline-ink
shadows.purpose: Active ticker cell marker — a tab underline drawn with the shadow primitive, not depth.

shadows.name: tab-underline-blue
shadows.purpose: Active new-only filter marker on the NEW block; blue because it is NEW's own identity.

motion.name: snapin
motion.value: snapin .01s steps(1,end) backwards; 420ms base delay + 8ms/row stagger (rows 1-52)
motion.purpose: Feed-connect arrival: rows appear whole, like a feed catching up. Inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: tick
motion.purpose: A committed status write flashes and settles, like a price update.

motion.name: pend
motion.purpose: In-flight write flash on the key row; static opacity .6 dim when motion is reduced.

motion.name: blink
motion.purpose: Toast arrival snap. No animation in this world eases or glides — steps() only.

narrative.overview:
The hub is a job search run as a market terminal. Listings are instruments on a watchlist, the pipeline is the portfolio, and NEW is the movers column. The world refuses the white-card job board entirely: no cards, no light surfaces, no imagery, no brand gradients. The material is true-black ruled data surfaces — four background steps from bg0 to bg3, white-to-gray inks, hairline rules — and the market metaphor is structural (density, the numbered index column, tick motion), never literal: no fake charts, no gain/loss color.

The page is near-total monochrome. Exactly one hue exists — blue — and it has exactly one job: NEW. Application status is a 10px authored mark plus a code word (HELD / APP / INT / OFF / REJ), never a hue. Selection and commitment are weight and monochrome inversion, not tint. Nothing glides: every state change is a steps() animation that snaps and settles like a price tick. Rows are 40px, labels are 9–10px tracked mono caps, every figure is tabular Chivo Mono, and the whole board runs from the keyboard (j/k/enter/s/a/i/o/x/u).
keyCharacteristics: True-black ruled data surfaces: four background steps, two hairline rules, three inks, one blue
One law per hue — blue means NEW and nothing else; no green, no red, anywhere
Status is a mark + code word; selection is weight and monochrome inversion
Flat and square: no shadows-as-depth, no radii (focus ring's 1px is the lone exception)
Nothing glides — all motion is steps(), gated behind prefers-reduced-motion
One oversized element: the 40px blue NEW figure, which never shrinks
Browser chrome themed in-world: inverted selection, white caret, dark scrollbar, 2px white focus ring, tabular numerals

rules.name: The One Law Per Hue Rule
rules.body: Blue = NEW. That is the whole chromatic vocabulary. There is no green, no red, no amber anywhere on the board: urgency is weight (a live deadline inside 14 days sets bold white; a passed one drops to ink-3 "CLOSED"), and rejection is loss of light (rows at opacity .4 with a line-through title), never a hue. A second hue, or a second job for blue, breaks the world.

rules.name: The Mark-Plus-Code Rule
rules.body: Application state is a 10px authored SVG mark plus a mono code word: outline square = HELD, filled square = APP / INT / OFF (in flight), stroke cross = REJ. State never gets a color; the marks differ by fill and the words differ by ink weight. Render-side statusCell() and client-side statusCellHTML() are the same rule in two runtimes and must never drift.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Chivo Mono renders every figure, code, and label; the system sans speaks every running word. No third family, no remote font, and numeric data is always tabular.

rules.name: The One Figure Rule
rules.body: The 40px NEW figure is the only oversized element the page may carry. At the 880px breakpoint the brand block yields (shrinks and truncates) so the figure never does. A second shouting number would repeal the law that makes the first one legible.

rules.name: The Nothing Glides Rule
rules.body: New motion must be a steps() snap, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion, with a static fallback. A transition or eased keyframe is a foreign material here — there are none in the build, and none may be added.

rules.name: The Ruled-Surface Rule
rules.body: New panels are separated by hairlines and background steps, never by shadow. If a surface needs to read as "above," it takes the next background step and a line-2 rule; if an element needs to read as "active," it inverts or takes the 2px inset underline.

rules.name: The Monochrome Inversion Rule
rules.body: A committed or focused state is a hard figure-ground flip in black and white — active keys, the keyboard cursor's index cell, active ticker underlines, ::selection. Never a tint, never a hue (blue's underline on the NEW block is NEW's identity, not a selection color).

dos: Do keep blue (#4D9FFF) on its one job: NEW, and nothing else — the figure, the status word, the divider band, the new-only underline, the favicon.
Do express state as an authored 10px mark + mono code word, and urgency as weight (bold white live deadlines, ink-3 passed ones).
Do make committed and focused states hard monochrome inversions with truthful aria-pressed / aria-current.
Do set every figure, label, and code in Chivo Mono — labels as tracked caps (0.14–0.24em), numerals always tabular-nums — and running words in the system sans.
Do build new motion as steps() snaps inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) with a static fallback; flashing states especially stay behind the gate.
Do separate new surfaces with line/line-2 hairlines and the four background steps; keep every control square with a 1px border.
Do theme browser chrome in-world on any new surface: inverted white selection, white caret, dark 10px scrollbar, the 2px white :focus-visible ring (1px radius).
Do keep render-side statusCell() and client-side statusCellHTML() in lockstep when states change — same rule, two runtimes.
donts: Don't introduce a second hue or a second job for blue — no green/red gain-loss color, no red errors, no amber warnings; this world's market metaphor is structural, never literal (no fake charts, no sparklines).
Don't add white cards, light surfaces, gradients, glows, drop shadows, or imagery — the only lawful box-shadow form is the 2px inset tab underline.
Don't round a corner (focus ring's 1px and the scrollbar thumb excepted), add a non-1px border, or bring in a pill or circle.
Don't ease, fade, slide, or transition anything — nothing glides; and don't author a second arrival moment: feed-connect owns it.
Don't oversize a second element — the 40px NEW figure is the page's single shout and never shrinks; competing scale dilutes it.
Don't add a third typeface or a remote font; the board loads one woff2.
